Author: Riphtix
Name: Custom Quest Guide
Punchline: Find what you want, discover how to get it, and track your progress.
Description: Custom Quest Guide helps you work toward the items, unlocks, and achievements you want in FFXIV. Search for gear, mounts, minions, titles, duties, jobs, relics, and curated sets; see acquisition methods and prerequisites; and pin your goals for quick access. Follow quest and NPC guidance, use map pins and duty shortcuts where available, and see which targets you already own or have unlocked.
